name: VPN
author: groot
description: WireGuard VPN control in the bar. Drop a .conf into the inbox, connect from a menu, and toggle a fail-closed nftables kill switch. Works with any WireGuard provider (Surfshark, Mullvad, self-hosted).

barWidget.description: Connect / disconnect WireGuard tunnels and toggle a fail-closed kill switch. Left-click opens the panel, right-click toggles the last tunnel.

schema.label: Show public IP / location
schema.description: After connecting, query an external service to show your apparent IP and city. Turn off for maximum privacy (no third-party request).

schema.label: Public-IP service URL
schema.description: HTTPS endpoint returning JSON with ip / city / country / org fields. Only used when the lookup above is enabled.

schema.label: Keep original .conf files
schema.description: Store a 0600 copy under ~/.local/state so a tunnel can be re-pinned to a fresh endpoint IP without re-uploading. If off, the upload is shredded after import and only NetworkManager keeps the key.
